title: tubella arbuscula
intro: Tubella arbuscula, commonly known as tree daphne, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Tubella arbuscula include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as wounds, fever, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Tubella arbuscula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
